note: Multiple 2026 cohort studies confirm biallelic RNU2-2 cases have earlier median seizure onset (10.5-18 months vs 21 months in dominant cases) with predominant infantile spasms and tonic seizures.

evidence.text: Biallelic RNU2-2 DEE individuals had a median seizure-onset age of 10.5 months (compared to 21 months in dominant cases), with infantile spasms and tonic seizures being the predominant seizure types.
